mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 3.5%, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST > 1600, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5), supply chain bottlenecks ease and manufacturing activity expands, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 102.5, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with broader economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 300 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 300, 60-day SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 156000 and UNRATE < 3.7, 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 102.0), supply chain disruptions and manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.0, 20-day SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over any 3-year window.
